entities.name: Terashi
entities.description: The great kami of the sun on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Favored Terashi and replaced its shrine with one for his immortality.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Location of the shrine to the Sun Kami.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Taken from the spirit realm, after which Terashi's shrine was replaced.

events.summary: Terashi's shrine in Eiganjo is replaced by one for Takeshi's immortality after Kyodai is taken from the spirit realm.
events.quote: Terashi's shrine was replaced by one erected for Takeshi's immortality

relations.quote: Terashi was one of the favored kami of Takeshi Konda
